statements.t: While our targeted market investments and LimePrime’s growth may temporarily affect near-term margins, we believe they also help secure our local market leadership.

We plan to continue to invest in long-term growth opportunities like LimePrime and market expansion, while also maintaining unit economics discipline and remaining focused on maximizing long-term free cash flow.
We are confident in our outlook and remain committed to driving durable, profitable growth and creating long-term shareholder value.”

We have not provided the GAAP net income (loss) outlook or a reconciliation of Adjusted EBITDA outlook to GAAP net income (loss) as a result of the uncertainty regarding, and the potential variability of, reconciling items such as stock-based compensation, acquisition related expense, and unrealized foreign exchange gains or losses.

By presenting Adjusted Gross Profit, Adjusted EBITDA, and Free Cash Flow we aim to provide investors with a view of our business and financial performance through the lens of management, offering an additional tool for comparing our operational results across multiple periods.
